title: StudioImportRequest
description: Body of POST /lessons/:lessonId/items/:item/import (2.18.0, AGB-1035; studio:admin only). The text is not sent: the Worker reads the version file already on the job branch and registers it as a style version in review.

expectedSha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file the caller looked at; another hash answers 409 text_changed_since_preview.
